metadata.scenario: An individual calls for the first time to inquire about the consultation process and available packages. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi, my name is Harold Gonzalez. I’m inquiring about your consultation process and available packages. Hi, Harold! I’d be happy to help you with that. Can I ask what specific services you're interested in? Well, I have a history of COPD and need regular nursing visits. My wife would also be present during the appointments. Absolutely, we can definitely accommodate that. We offer skilled nursing care, which includes vital sign checks and medication management. That sounds good. Could you tell me more about the pricing and how often I would need visits? Our skilled nursing care is priced between $95 and $125 per visit, usually lasting 1-2 hours. We recommend visits based on your needs, typically every week. Okay, and how do I set up a consultation to get started? To start the consultation process, we would conduct an initial assessment, which is free of charge, to determine your specific needs. That makes sense. How do I schedule that? I can assist you with scheduling right now. What days and times work best for you and your wife? We are generally free on Tuesdays and Thursdays in the afternoon. Great! Let’s schedule it for Tuesday at 2 PM. Does that work for you? Yes, that sounds perfect. Excellent! I’ll note that down. After the assessment, we can discuss what package works best for your needs. What packages do you offer? We have a variety of options, including skilled nursing, personal care assistance, and medication management. Each has different pricing and services. Can you give me an example of the personal care services? Sure! Personal care assistance includes help with bathing, dressing, grooming, and daily hygiene. It’s priced at $28 to $35 per hour. That could be helpful as well. I might consider that alongside nursing visits. Absolutely, I can discuss that in more detail during the assessment. Is there anything else you would like to know? No, I think that covers everything for now. Thank you for your assistance! You’re welcome, Harold! I look forward to seeing you and your wife on Tuesday at 2 PM. Thank you! See you then. Have a great day!
